_comment: Copied to <project-root>/<project>/landing-page-analyzer/config.json on first run. Replace placeholders. Never commit a real config to the agent folder. Optional: add a tools object (keys from shared/tools.md, for example screenshot, scrape, page_speed) to override the project tools.json for this agent. repo (optional): path to the site source code on this machine, for example ../acme-site; when set, scripts/repo_patch.py turns every fix validated by the before/after into a patch against it (the repo is only read, never written or committed). Leave it empty when the site is edited only in a hosted builder.
